trigger AccountAddError on Account (before insert) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.get('Name') == 'Block') { a.Name.addError('blocked by trigger'); } if (a.get('Name') == 'Multi Block') { a.addError('blocked at record'); a.Name.addError('blocked at name'); a.Rating.addError('blocked at rating'); } if (a.get('Name') == 'Overload Block') { a.addError('object overload', false); a.Rating.addError('unset field overload', true); } } }

trigger AccountBeforeUpdateContext on Account (before update) { System.assert(Trigger.isExecuting); System.assert(Trigger.isBefore); System.assert(Trigger.isUpdate); System.assertEquals(1, Trigger.size); Account newer = Trigger.new.get(0); if (newer.get('Name') == 'After') { Account older = Trigger.oldMap.get(newer.Id); System.assertEquals('Before', older.Name); System.assertEquals('After', newer.Name); Account byMap = Trigger.newMap.get(newer.Id); byMap.Rating = 'Warm'; newer.Name = 'After!'; } }

trigger AccountBeforeDeleteContext on Account (before delete) { System.assert(Trigger.isExecuting); System.assert(Trigger.isBefore); System.assert(Trigger.isDelete); System.assertEquals(null, Trigger.new); System.assertEquals(null, Trigger.newMap); Account oldRow = Trigger.old.get(0); System.assert(Trigger.oldMap.containsKey(oldRow.Id)); }

@isTest private class TriggerAddErrorTest { @isTest static void triggerAddErrorShapesDmlResults() { Account ok = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); Account blocked = new Account(Name = 'Block'); List<Account> records = new List<Account>{ok, blocked}; List<Object> results = Database.insert(records, false); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); Object first = results.get(0); Object second = results.get(1); System.assert(first.isSuccess()); System.assert(!second.isSuccess()); List<Object> errors = second.getErrors(); System.assertEquals(1, errors.size()); Object err = errors.get(0); System.assertEquals('FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION', err.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('blocked by trigger', err.getMessage()); List<Object> fields = err.getFields(); System.assertEquals(1, fields.size()); System.assertEquals('Name', fields.get(0)); List<Account> survivors = [SELECT Id FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(1, survivors.size()); } }

@isTest private class TriggerMultiErrorTest { @isTest static void triggerAddErrorKeepsAllDatabaseErrors() { Account blocked = new Account(Name = 'Multi Block', Rating = 'Hot'); List<Object> results = Database.insert(new List<Account>{blocked}, false); Object result = results.get(0); System.assert(!result.isSuccess()); List<Object> errors = result.getErrors(); System.assertEquals(3, errors.size()); Object recordError = errors.get(0); System.assertEquals('blocked at record', recordError.getMessage()); List<Object> recordFields = recordError.getFields(); System.assertEquals(0, recordFields.size()); Object nameError = errors.get(1); System.assertEquals('blocked at name', nameError.getMessage()); List<Object> nameFields = nameError.getFields(); System.assertEquals(1, nameFields.size()); System.assertEquals('Name', nameFields.get(0)); Object ratingError = errors.get(2); System.assertEquals('blocked at rating', ratingError.getMessage()); List<Object> ratingFields = ratingError.getFields(); System.assertEquals(1, ratingFields.size()); System.assertEquals('Rating', ratingFields.get(0)); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Multi Block']; System.assertEquals(0, rows.size()); } }

@isTest private class TriggerContextFidelityTest { @isTest static void updateAndDeleteContextMaps() { Account a = new Account(Name = 'Before'); insert a; a.Name = 'After'; update a; Account updated = [SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Id = :a.Id]; System.assertEquals('After!', updated.Name); System.assertEquals('Warm', updated.Rating); delete updated; } }

trigger AccountBulkBeforeInsert on Account (before insert) { if (Trigger.size == 3) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.get('Name') == 'Bulk Block') { a.Name.addError('blocked by bulk trigger'); } else if (a.get('Name') == 'Bulk First' || a.get('Name') == 'Bulk Second') { a.Rating = 'Bulk'; } } } }

trigger AccountBulkAfterInsert on Account (after insert) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.get('Name') == 'Bulk First' || a.get('Name') == 'Bulk Second') { insert new Contact(LastName = 'after-' + a.Name); } } }

@isTest private class TriggerBulkFidelityTest { @isTest static void failedFirstBulkInsertKeepsResultAlignment() { Account blocked = new Account(Name = 'Bulk Block'); Account first = new Account(Name = 'Bulk First'); Account second = new Account(Name = 'Bulk Second'); List<Account> records = new List<Account>{blocked, first, second}; List<Object> results = Database.insert(records, false); System.assertEquals(3, results.size()); Object r0 = results.get(0); Object r1 = results.get(1); Object r2 = results.get(2); System.assert(!r0.isSuccess()); System.assert(r1.isSuccess()); System.assert(r2.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(null, blocked.get('Id')); System.assert(first.get('Id') != null); System.assert(second.get('Id') != null); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Name IN ('Bulk First', 'Bulk Second') ORDER BY Name]; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); Account row0 = rows.get(0); Account row1 = rows.get(1); System.assertEquals('Bulk First', row0.Name); System.assertEquals('Bulk', row0.Rating); System.assertEquals('Bulk Second', row1.Name); System.assertEquals('Bulk', row1.Rating); List<Contact> markers = [SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE LastName IN ('after-Bulk First', 'after-Bulk Second')]; System.assertEquals(2, markers.size()); } }

trigger AccountRecursiveBeforeInsert on Account (before insert) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.get('Name') == 'Recursive Root' || a.get('Name') == 'Recursive') { insert new Account(Name = 'Recursive'); } } }

@isTest private class TriggerRecursionFidelityTest { @isTest static void recursiveTriggerStopsWithDmlException() { Boolean caught = false; try { insert new Account(Name = 'Recursive Root'); } catch (DmlException e) { caught = true; String message = e.getMessage(); System.assert(message.contains('maximum trigger depth')); } System.assert(caught); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Recursive Root' OR Name = 'Recursive']; System.assertEquals(0, rows.size()); } }

trigger AccountMergeBeforeUpdate on Account (before update) { Account newer = Trigger.new.get(0); if (newer.get('Name') == 'Merged Name') { System.assert(Trigger.isExecuting); System.assert(Trigger.isBefore); System.assert(Trigger.isUpdate); Account older = Trigger.oldMap.get(newer.Id); System.assertEquals('Merge Master For Triggers', older.Name); newer.Rating = 'merge-before-update'; } }

trigger AccountMergeAfterUpdate on Account (after update) { Account newer = Trigger.new.get(0); if (newer.get('Name') == 'Merged Name') { System.assert(Trigger.isExecuting); System.assert(Trigger.isAfter); System.assert(Trigger.isUpdate); Account older = Trigger.oldMap.get(newer.Id); System.assertEquals('Merge Master For Triggers', older.Name); System.assertEquals('merge-before-update', newer.Rating); insert new Contact(LastName = 'merge-update-fired'); } }

trigger AccountMergeAfterDelete on Account (after delete) { Account oldRow = Trigger.old.get(0); if (oldRow.get('Name') == 'Merge Duplicate For Triggers') { System.assert(Trigger.isExecuting); System.assert(Trigger.isAfter); System.assert(Trigger.isDelete); System.assertEquals(null, Trigger.new); System.assert(Trigger.oldMap.containsKey(oldRow.Id)); insert new Contact(LastName = 'merge-delete-fired'); } }

trigger AccountMergeBeforeDeleteBlock on Account (before delete) { Account oldRow = Trigger.old.get(0); if (oldRow.get('Name') == 'Blocked Merge Duplicate') { oldRow.addError('blocked duplicate merge'); } }

trigger AccountAfterUndeleteContext on Account (after undelete) { System.assert(Trigger.isExecuting); System.assert(Trigger.isAfter); System.assert(Trigger.isUndelete); System.assertEquals(1, Trigger.size); System.assertEquals(null, Trigger.old); System.assertEquals(null, Trigger.oldMap); Account newer = Trigger.new.get(0); System.assert(Trigger.newMap.containsKey(newer.Id)); }

trigger AccountUpsertBeforeInsert on Account (before insert) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.get('External_Key__c') == 'upsert-new') { System.assert(Trigger.isInsert); a.Rating = 'upsert-before-insert'; } } }

trigger AccountUpsertAfterInsert on Account (after insert) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.get('External_Key__c') == 'upsert-new') { System.assert(Trigger.isAfter); System.assert(Trigger.isInsert); insert new Contact(LastName = 'upsert-insert-fired'); } } }

trigger AccountUpsertBeforeUpdate on Account (before update) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.get('External_Key__c') == 'UPSERT-EXISTING') { System.assert(Trigger.isUpdate); Account older = Trigger.oldMap.get(a.Id); System.assertEquals('Upsert Existing', older.Name); a.Rating = 'upsert-before-update'; } } }

trigger AccountUpsertAfterUpdate on Account (after update) { for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.get('External_Key__c') == 'UPSERT-EXISTING') { System.assert(Trigger.isAfter); System.assert(Trigger.isUpdate); insert new Contact(LastName = 'upsert-update-fired'); } } }

@isTest private class MergeTriggerFidelityTest { @isTest static void mergeFiresUpdateAndDeleteTriggers() { Account master = new Account(Name = 'Merge Master For Triggers'); insert master; Account duplicate = new Account(Name = 'Merge Duplicate For Triggers'); insert duplicate; Account mergeMaster = new Account(Id = master.Id, Name = 'Merged Name'); Object result = Database.merge(mergeMaster, duplicate, false); System.assert(result.isSuccess()); Account row = [SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Id = :master.Id]; System.assertEquals('Merged Name', row.Name); System.assertEquals('merge-before-update', row.Rating); List<Contact> updateMarkers = [SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'merge-update-fired']; System.assertEquals(1, updateMarkers.size()); List<Contact> deleteMarkers = [SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'merge-delete-fired']; System.assertEquals(1, deleteMarkers.size()); Account blockedMaster = new Account(Name = 'Blocked Merge Master'); insert blockedMaster; Account blockedDuplicate = new Account(Name = 'Blocked Merge Duplicate'); insert blockedDuplicate; Account blockedUpdate = new Account(Id = blockedMaster.Id, Name = 'Blocked Applied'); Object blockedResult = Database.merge(blockedUpdate, blockedDuplicate, false); System.assert(!blockedResult.isSuccess()); List<Object> blockedErrors = blockedResult.getErrors(); System.assertEquals(1, blockedErrors.size()); Object blockedError = blockedErrors.get(0); System.assertEquals('blocked duplicate merge', blockedError.getMessage()); List<Account> blockedRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :blockedDuplicate.Id]; System.assertEquals(1, blockedRows.size()); } }

@isTest private class AggregateFidelityTest { @isTest static void aggregateFunctionsReturnExprFields() { insert new Account(Name = 'Acme', AnnualRevenue = 100, Rating = 'Hot'); insert new Account(Name = 'Beta', AnnualRevenue = 250, Rating = 'Warm'); insert new Account(Name = 'Gamma', AnnualRevenue = 300, Rating = 'Hot'); List<Object> rows = [SELECT COUNT(Name) namedCount, COUNT_DISTINCT(Rating), SUM(AnnualRevenue) totalRevenue, MIN(AnnualRevenue), MAX(AnnualRevenue), AVG(AnnualRevenue) averageRevenue FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Object row = rows.get(0); System.assertEquals(3, row.expr0); System.assertEquals(2, row.expr1); System.assertEquals(650.0, row.expr2); System.assertEquals(100.0, row.expr3); System.assertEquals(300.0, row.expr4); System.assertEquals(216.6666666667, row.expr5); System.assertEquals(3, row.namedCount); System.assertEquals(650.0, row.totalRevenue); System.assertEquals(216.6666666667, row.averageRevenue); List<Object> grouped = [SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount, SUM(AnnualRevenue) totalRevenue FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING accountCount > 1 ORDER BY totalRevenue]; System.assertEquals(1, grouped.size()); Object groupRow = grouped.get(0); System.assertEquals('Hot', groupRow.Rating); System.assertEquals(2, groupRow.expr0); System.assertEquals(400.0, groupRow.expr1); System.assertEquals(2, groupRow.accountCount); System.assertEquals(400.0, groupRow.totalRevenue); List<Object> rollupRows = [SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount, GROUPING(Rating) ratingGrouped FROM Account GROUP BY ROLLUP(Rating) ORDER BY ratingGrouped]; System.assertEquals(3, rollupRows.size()); Object totalRow = rollupRows.get(2); System.assertEquals(null, totalRow.Rating); System.assertEquals(3, totalRow.accountCount); System.assertEquals(1, totalRow.ratingGrouped); List<Object> cubeRows = [SELECT Rating, Name, COUNT(Id) accountCount, GROUPING(Rating) ratingGrouped, GROUPING(Name) nameGrouped FROM Account GROUP BY CUBE(Rating, Name) HAVING accountCount >= 2]; System.assertEquals(2, cubeRows.size()); } }

@isTest private class DescribeFidelityTest { @isTest static void describeFieldsMapAndRecordTypes() { Object accountType = Account.SObjectType; Object accountDescribe = accountType.getDescribe(); Object fieldsToken = accountDescribe.fields; Map<String,Object> fields = fieldsToken.getMap(); System.assert(fields.containsKey('Name')); Object nameField = fields.get('Name'); Object nameDescribe = nameField.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('Name', nameDescribe.getName()); System.assertEquals('string', nameDescribe.getType()); Object ratingDescribe = Account.Rating.getDescribe(); List<Object> picklists = ratingDescribe.getPicklistValues(); System.assertEquals(3, picklists.size()); Object hot = picklists.get(0); System.assertEquals('Hot Label', hot.getLabel()); Map<String,Object> byDeveloperName = accountDescribe.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName(); Object business = byDeveloperName.get('Business'); System.assertEquals('Business Account', business.getName()); Object schemaType = Schema.SObjectType.Account; Object schemaDescribe = schemaType.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('Account', schemaDescribe.getName()); List<Object> childRelationships = schemaDescribe.getChildRelationships(); System.assertEquals(3, childRelationships.size()); Object contacts = childRelationships.get(1); System.assertEquals('Contacts', contacts.getRelationshipName()); Object childField = contacts.getField(); Object childFieldDescribe = childField.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('AccountId', childFieldDescribe.getName()); Object childType = contacts.getChildSObject(); Object childDescribe = childType.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('Contact', childDescribe.getName()); System.assert(contacts.isCascadeDelete()); } }

@isTest private class PolymorphicRelationshipFidelityTest { @isTest static void whoRelationshipUsesActualTargetType() { Account a = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); insert a; Contact c = new Contact(LastName = 'Smith'); insert c; Task accountTask = new Task(Subject = 'A', WhoId = a.Id); Task contactTask = new Task(Subject = 'C', WhoId = c.Id); insert new List<Task>{accountTask, contactTask}; List<Task> rows = [SELECT Id, Subject, Who.Name, TYPEOF Who WHEN Account THEN Name WHEN Contact THEN LastName END FROM Task ORDER BY Subject]; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); Task first = rows.get(0); System.assertEquals('Acme', first.Who.Name); Task second = rows.get(1); System.assertEquals('Smith', second.Who.LastName); } }

@isTest private class QueryRowShapeFidelityTest { @isTest static void serializedRowsIncludeAttributesUrl() { Account a = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); insert a; Account row = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :a.Id]; String text = JSON.serialize(row); Object decoded = JSON.deserializeUntyped(text); Object attrs = decoded.get('attributes'); System.assertEquals('Account', attrs.get('type')); System.assertEquals('/services/data/v60.0/sobjects/Account/' + a.Id, attrs.get('url')); } }

@isTest private class ValidationRuleFidelityTest { @isTest static void metadataValidationRuleBlocksDml() { Account blocked = new Account(Name = 'Rule Block'); Object result = Database.insert(blocked, false); System.assert(!result.isSuccess()); List<Object> errors = result.getErrors(); System.assertEquals(1, errors.size()); Object err = errors.get(0); System.assertEquals('FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION', err.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('blocked by validation rule', err.getMessage()); List<Object> fields = err.getFields(); System.assertEquals(1, fields.size()); System.assertEquals('Name', fields.get(0)); } }

@isTest private class AddErrorOverloadFidelityTest { @isTest static void addErrorSupportsOptionalEscapeAndUnsetFields() { Account blocked = new Account(Name = 'Overload Block'); Object result = Database.insert(blocked, false); System.assert(!result.isSuccess()); List<Object> errors = result.getErrors(); System.assertEquals(2, errors.size()); Object objectError = errors.get(0); System.assertEquals('object overload', objectError.getMessage()); Object fieldError = errors.get(1); System.assertEquals('unset field overload', fieldError.getMessage()); List<Object> fields = fieldError.getFields(); System.assertEquals(1, fields.size()); System.assertEquals('Rating', fields.get(0)); } }

@isTest private class UndeleteTriggerFidelityTest { @isTest static void afterUndeleteContextRuns() { Account a = new Account(Name = 'Undelete Me'); insert a; delete a; undelete a; System.assert(!a.IsDeleted); } }

@isTest private class UpsertTriggerFidelityTest { @isTest static void upsertFiresInsertAndUpdateTriggers() { Account existing = new Account(Name = 'Upsert Existing', External_Key__c = 'upsert-existing'); insert existing; Account inserted = new Account(Name = 'Upsert Inserted', External_Key__c = 'upsert-new'); Account updated = new Account(Name = 'Upsert Updated', External_Key__c = 'UPSERT-EXISTING'); upsert new List<Account>{inserted, updated} External_Key__c; Account insertedRow = [SELECT Id, Rating FROM Account WHERE External_Key__c = 'upsert-new']; System.assertEquals('upsert-before-insert', insertedRow.Rating); Account updatedRow = [SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Id = :existing.Id]; System.assertEquals('Upsert Updated', updatedRow.Name); System.assertEquals('upsert-before-update', updatedRow.Rating); List<Contact> insertMarkers = [SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'upsert-insert-fired']; System.assertEquals(1, insertMarkers.size()); List<Contact> updateMarkers = [SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'upsert-update-fired']; System.assertEquals(1, updateMarkers.size()); } }

@isTest private class DataFidelityTest { @isTest static void soqlComplexPredicates() { Account acme = new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 100, Score__c = 7); insert acme; insert new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm', AnnualRevenue = 200); insert new Account(Name = 'Gamma', Rating = 'Cold', AnnualRevenue = 300); insert new Contact(LastName = 'Smith', AccountId = acme.Id); insert new Contact(LastName = 'Jones', AccountId = acme.Id); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name IN ('Acme', 'Beta')]; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name NOT IN ('Acme', 'Beta')]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'a%']; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '_CME']; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Rating ASC NULLS LAST, Name DESC LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Account sortedRow = rows.get(0); System.assertEquals('Gamma', sortedRow.Name); rows = [SELECT FIELDS(ALL) FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Acme' WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED FOR UPDATE]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Account fieldsRow = rows.get(0); System.assertEquals(7.0, fieldsRow.Score__c); Boolean securityCaught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT Missing__c FROM Account WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED'); } catch (QueryException qe) { securityCaught = true; String securityMessage = qe.getMessage(); System.assert(securityMessage.contains('Missing__c')); } System.assert(securityCaught); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue > 150]; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue >= 200]; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue < 200]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE AnnualRevenue <= 100]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Acme' AND Rating = 'Hot']; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Acme' OR Name = 'Gamma']; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE (Name = 'Acme' OR Name = 'Beta') AND Rating = 'Warm']; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE NOT Name = 'Acme']; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'Smith')]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'Smith')]; System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); List<Contact> contacts = [SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE AccountId IN (SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Acme')]; System.assertEquals(2, contacts.size()); rows = [SELECT Id, (SELECT Id, LastName FROM Contacts WHERE LastName != 'Jones' ORDER BY LastName LIMIT 1) FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Acme']; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Account childRow = rows.get(0); List<Contact> childContacts = childRow.Contacts; System.assertEquals(1, childContacts.size()); Contact childContact = childContacts.get(0); System.assertEquals('Smith', childContact.LastName); List<Contact> typeRows = [SELECT Id, TYPEOF Account WHEN Account THEN Name END FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'Smith']; System.assertEquals(1, typeRows.size()); Contact typeRow = typeRows.get(0); System.assertEquals('Acme', typeRow.Account.Name); } @isTest static void dmlResultShape() { Account good = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); Account missing = new Account(); Account bad = new Account(Bogus__c = 'nope'); List<Account> records = new List<Account>{good, missing, bad}; List<Object> results = Database.insert(records, false); Object row0 = results.get(0); System.assert(row0.isSuccess()); Object row1 = results.get(1); System.assert(!row1.isSuccess()); Object row2 = results.get(2); System.assert(!row2.isSuccess()); List<Object> errors2 = row1.getErrors(); Object err2 = errors2.get(0); System.assertEquals('REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING', err2.getStatusCode()); List<Object> fields2 = err2.getFields(); System.assertEquals(1, fields2.size()); System.assertEquals('Name', fields2.get(0)); List<Object> errors3 = row2.getErrors(); Object err3 = errors3.get(0); System.assertEquals('INVALID_FIELD_FOR_INSERT_UPDATE', err3.getStatusCode()); List<Object> fields3 = err3.getFields(); System.assertEquals(1, fields3.size()); System.assertEquals('Bogus__c', fields3.get(0)); Account upsertNew = new Account(Name = 'NewCo'); Object upsertCreate = Database.upsert(upsertNew, false); System.assert(upsertCreate.isSuccess()); System.assert(upsertCreate.isCreated()); Account upsertExisting = new Account(Id = upsertCreate.getId(), Name = 'OldCo'); Object upsertUpdate = Database.upsert(upsertExisting, false); System.assert(upsertUpdate.isSuccess()); System.assert(!upsertUpdate.isCreated()); } @isTest static void dmlIntegrityAndUndelete() { Account first = new Account(Name = 'Acme', External_Key__c = 'ext-1', Code__c = 'A'); Object created = Database.upsert(first, false); System.assert(created.isSuccess()); System.assert(created.isCreated()); Account second = new Account(External_Key__c = 'EXT-1', Name = 'Changed'); Object updated = Database.upsert(second, false); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); System.assert(!updated.isCreated()); System.assertEquals(created.getId(), updated.getId()); Account explicit = new Account(Other_Key__c = 'other-1', Name = 'Explicit'); Object explicitCreated = Database.upsert(explicit, Account.Other_Key__c, false); System.assert(explicitCreated.isSuccess()); System.assert(explicitCreated.isCreated()); Account explicitUpdate = new Account(Other_Key__c = 'OTHER-1', Name = 'Explicit Changed'); Object explicitUpdated = Database.upsert(explicitUpdate, Account.Fields.Other_Key__c, false); System.assert(explicitUpdated.isSuccess()); System.assert(!explicitUpdated.isCreated()); System.assertEquals(explicitCreated.getId(), explicitUpdated.getId()); Account statementCreate = new Account(Other_Key__c = 'other-2', Name = 'Statement'); upsert statementCreate Other_Key__c; Account statementUpdate = new Account(Other_Key__c = 'OTHER-2', Name = 'Statement Changed'); upsert statementUpdate Other_Key__c; System.assertEquals(statementCreate.Id, statementUpdate.Id); List<Account> changed = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE External_Key__c = 'EXT-1']; System.assertEquals(1, changed.size()); Account changedRow = changed.get(0); System.assertEquals('Changed', changedRow.Name); List<Account> explicitChanged = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Other_Key__c = 'OTHER-1']; System.assertEquals(1, explicitChanged.size()); Account explicitRow = explicitChanged.get(0); System.assertEquals('Explicit Changed', explicitRow.Name); List<Account> statementChanged = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Other_Key__c = 'OTHER-2']; System.assertEquals(1, statementChanged.size()); Account statementRow = statementChanged.get(0); System.assertEquals('Statement Changed', statementRow.Name); Account duplicate = new Account(Name = 'Dup', Code__c = 'a'); Object duplicateResult = Database.insert(duplicate, false); System.assert(!duplicateResult.isSuccess()); List<Object> duplicateErrors = duplicateResult.getErrors(); Object duplicateError = duplicateErrors.get(0);
